mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_node_exec (exec_id, turn_id, session_id, seq, node_id, node_type, input_state, status) VALUES (#{execId}, #{turnId}, #{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{nodeId}, #{nodeType}, CAST(#{inputStateJson} AS jsonb), 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_node_exec SET output_update = CAST(#{outputUpdateJson} AS jsonb), status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, finished_at = now() WHERE exec_id = #{execId}
mapper.select: SELECT exec_id, seq, node_id, node_type, input_state::text AS input_state, output_update::text AS output_update, status, error_msg, latency_ms, started_at FROM flow_node_exec WHERE turn_id = #{turnId} ORDER BY seq
